items.name: Cloak of Resistance +3
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Amulet of Natural Armor +1
items.description: This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales—toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.

items.description:

StatisticsDamage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x3; Range -; Type P
Weapon Groups Close
DescriptionA punching dagger's blade is attached to a horizontal handle that projects out from the fist when held.

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.name: Headband of Alluring Charisma +2
items.description:
This attractive silver headband is decorated with a number of small red and orange gemstones.

The headband grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Charisma of +2, +4, or +6. Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the headband is worn.
